source: The New York Times New York
title: Thelma Golden to Step Down as Head of Studio Museum in Harlem
summary: After 21 years at the helm of the Studio Museum in Harlem, where she completed its new home and helped redefine the art canon, Thelma Golden has decided it’s time to go.
caption: Thelma Golden, director and chief curator of the Studio Museum in Harlem, has been a decisive force in the art world for decades. She’s “open and curious” about what comes next.
